title: CIFailure
description: Structured data representing a CI test or build failure.

check_name.description: The name of the CI check (e.g., 'Build & E2E', 'Lint', 'Type Check').

file.description: Path to the file where the error occurred.

message.description: The error message or failure description.

context.description: Additional context, such as the test name or a code snippet.

reproduction_command.description: The command recommended to reproduce the failure locally.
